Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a finished, very wide landscape editorial cover for a Chinese personal blog and a WeChat public-account article. Aspect ratio about 2.35:1. Maintain a consistent restrained magazine design: warm ivory paper background (#f3eddf), charcoal black Chinese type, muted sage green and warm terracotta accents, hand-cut paper illustration with subtle pencil texture. Crisp readable type, sophisticated quiet composition, generous whitespace. Title on the left and subject illustration on the right, with all important elements at least 6% away from edges for cover cropping. Small top-left label 'NOTE' and small bottom-left signature 'k_fad'. No other text, watermarks or brand logos. No 3D, photography, neon, glossy robots or fake screenshots. Render the exact requested title legibly.
Exact Chinese title, two lines:「家乡的素材」「孩子熟悉吗？」. A few simple material cards connect the neighborhood to the notebook, evoking AI as a gentle aid to remembering the child's own life. No famous landmarks or tourist spectacle. Child's real experience should be the focal idea.
